description: tools/test-projects/crash-diagnostics (WEB_PROJECT=crash-diagnostics tools/build.sh web), opened with ?jasperengine_debug_crash=abort: the development build aborts 30 frames after its scenes loaded (after the ready line) and the page hooks (engine/platform/emscripten/crash_pre.js) log JASPERENGINE CRASH: with the stack and the log tail and call window.jasperengine.onCrash, which init_script defines before the page loads; the report carries the Gameplay Journal (lua/main.lua logs gate.ready) and the Lua user report is read back from memory. The abort's own errors are allowed.
init_script: window.jasperengine = { onCrash: function (report) { window.jasperengineCrashTest = { stack: report.stack.length > 0, logTail: report.logTail.indexOf('[gate] crash diagnostics: cpp init') >= 0, message: report.message, buildHash: report.buildHash, journal: typeof report.journal == 'string' && report.journal.indexOf('gate.ready') >= 0 }; } };
expect: [gate] crash diagnostics: user report file true
